newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Hamilton, Tenn.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Hamilton, Tenn.

text.p: SEALED BIDS will be received on an all or none basis until 11:00 a.m., Eastern Daylight Savings Time, on

(or at such other time or date announced via Munifacts by 3:00 p.m., Eastern Daylight Savings Time, on the last business day prior to any announced date for receipt of bids) at the County Courthouse in Chattanooga, Tennessee, at an interest rate or rates not exceeding 12%, for the purchase of General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997A, issued in the approximate aggregate amount of $53,000,000 (the Bonds) by Hamilton County, Tennessee (the County''). The proceeds of the sale of the Bonds are to be used for the purpose of providing funds (i) to finance the design, acquisition, construction, renovation, equipping and

furnishing of various governmental projects as more fully described in the Preliminary Official Statement dated April 28, 1997, and (ii) to pay the costs of issuing the Bonds. The Bonds will be dated May 1, 1997 and will be issued in denominations of $5,000 or integral multiples thereof and will be initially registered in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee for The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York. The Bonds will mature serially on May 1 in each of the years 1998 through 2007, both inclusive, in principal amounts established in accordance with the award of the Bonds and, unless a bidder designates one or more term bonds, as provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale, will also mature serially on May 1 in each of the years 2008 through 2012, both inclusive, in principal amounts established in accordance with the award of the Bonds. Each bid for the Bonds must be for all of said Bonds offered and for not less than 99% of the aggregate principal amount of said Bonds, plus accrued interest from the dated date to the date of delivery. The Bonds will be awarded on the basis of the lowest interest cost to the County determined in accordance with the true interest cost (TIC) method, as more particularly described in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The Bonds maturing on or before May 1, 2007 are not subject to redemption before their stated maturities. The Bonds maturing after May 1, 2007 are subject to redemption in the manner described in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The validity and enforceability of the Bonds will be approved by Long Aldridge Norman LLP, One Peachtree Center, Suite 5300, 303 Peachtree Street, Atlanta, Georgia 30308, phone: (404) 527-4000. The unqualified, final, approving opinion of Bond Counsel, together with a copy of the printed Bonds (which will be delivered to The Depository Trust Company, New York on behalf of the original purchaser

including such opinion printed thereon), and a transcri the legal proceedings, will be furnished to the purchaser without charge. Additional information, including the Detailed Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the undersigned at the County Courthouse in Chattanooga, Tennessee 37402 or from the financial advisor, Alex. Brown & Sons Incorporated, 6201 Fairview Road, Suite 201, Charlotte, North Carolina 28210, (704) 552-6240 (Attention: Joseph A. Niggel).
